author: Sage
name: Sage sample: Vvardenfell lite (Morrowind-style town)
description: A Morrowind-style town in data only, on the RPG kit: topic dialogue, a quest, a blade skill that rises with use, a trader, and 1P/3P. Phase 5 sample (issue #577). dotnet run starts it.

sdkVersion.description: The Sage.Sdk version the projects name (Sage.Sdk/version in each Sdk attribute). The pack sets the default to the version packed (build/Sage.Version.props, from git tags); pass it when installing the template straight from its folder.

feed.description: A local NuGet feed holding Sage.Sdk and Sage.Player (tools/pack_sdk.sh writes one). Writes a nuget.config that names it; without it, the feed must already be a package source.
